read_window_condition: This task is the service single active job. After original-byte preparation, no task subprocess writes the input directory or files. The compiler source reader only reads them. Acceptance assumes no out-of-band host writes; physical identities and content hashes are checked before/after.
replay_boundary: Kernel replay checks embedded literals and proof objects, and inherits the original fresh data-to-object binding; it does not reread the source JSON.
reuse_boundary: The unchanged accepted floor core and source/dependency-bound helper records may be reused; the failed or source-changed finite root must compile under this new original-input snapshot.
